definitions.explanation: A student enrolled in a faculty of medicine, training to become a doctor. The Japanese medical program is six years, so {医学生|いがくせい} typically spans first through sixth-year students.

examples.japanese: ⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{医学生|いがくせい}だ。
examples.english: My younger brother is a medical student.

examples.japanese: {医学生|いがくせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}われる→追う：02016_ou⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}っている→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: Medical students spend their days chased by exams.

examples.japanese: {六年生|ろくねんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{医学生|いがくせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{実習|じっしゅう}→実習：03077_jisshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Sixth-year medical students do their clinical training at hospitals.

notes:
⟦{医学|いがく}→医学：01301_igaku⟧ (medicine) + {生|せい} (student). The {生|せい} suffix attaches to fields to form names for students of that field.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {医学生|いがくせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a medical student
- {医学生|いがくせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実習|じっしゅう}→実習：03077_jisshuu⟧: medical-student clinical training
- {医学生|いがくせい}⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧: one's days as a medical student

STUDENT SUFFIXES ({生|せい}):
- ⟦{大学生|だいがくせい}→大学生：01653_daigakusei⟧: university student
- ⟦{高校生|こうこうせい}→高校生：01580_koukousei⟧: high-school student
- ⟦{留学生|りゅうがくせい}→留学生：02986_ryuugakusei⟧: international student
- {歯学生|しがくせい}: dental student

RELATED WORDS:
- {研修医|けんしゅうい}: medical resident (after graduation, in training)
- ⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧: doctor, physician (licensed)
